div.div: Looks through the multiple possible sources of resets in hardware flags, clears them and stores the true reset reason. It is also responsible for determining if the reset is due to an error injection in the FSM task. If that is the case, it stores the reset reason in a separate location in order to avoid overwriting the true reset reason.

div.div: When the STRICT_SAFE_STATE setting is enabled, this task will always force floating of all I/O pins. The system will remain floated regardless of PORT settings on the device until starting the mission mode in the Startup task manager. When disabled, the force float is only enabled if any I/O pins are not tri-stated out of reset (due to a fault).
